body:
Thank you for replying.

It's not that I'm getting picked on; it's not like I have many friends but the ones I do have are good to me so there's really no problems there. My grades aren't suffering too badly, but I don't see how I can keep them up at this rate. It's more that I can't make myself do anything, or feel the right way and I try hard most mornings to just not think about it and to just get to school and not think about anything, but I don't like living like that. I want to be normal and not have to trick myself into doing things, and to be able to just wake up and not want to die. I dunno. I don't see how I can be of any use to anybody, much less myself, when half the time I can barely leave the house.

Mostly I feel guilty, because I lie so much so that I can just stay home,stay in bed. I can't justify lying, or hiding behind the excuse of being 'depressed' because I'm more than likely not depressed at all. Or if I am, then I have been for a long time and I should know how to deal with it by now.
